what: Nine more Advanced Temporary Fencing hire agreements, 36642-36650, installed 21 and 22 Oct 2026 (the event week), signed and photographed (Andrew, 23 Oct 2026, the second lot of photographs, sent without words); recorded through the page's own red-book form (recordHireAgreement) and charged at the 2026 card. Every figure read twice at full size and by an independent reader. 'Braced & Scrim' written on the paper is clean plus scrim for the same metres (the convention set on 2 Oct); CCB event or demarcation follows the programme request and the operational plan as the earlier dockets did (Club 500 creek protection is Event as 36591; the inlet on Breaker St is Demarcation, EVENT WEEK row 72); wheels are components (no gate line on any paper; vehicle gates are inside the card's metre); bracing-only papers are components only.
